lowered_because: 78 tail candidates seeded for the preliminary language_specific_datasets category (#686) introduced candidate-org slugs ahead of their handles: a tail row names its org but declares no handle until promotion, so the github, huggingface and homepage_domain denominators grow while the numerators do not. No handle was removed and no existing mapping regressed. The 53 new orgs - among them ai4bharat, ai-singapore, masakhane, mozilla-foundation, open-language-data-initiative, seacrowd, hitz, mbzuai, linguistic-data-consortium and te-hiku-media - get handles at promotion, which is when the numerator catches up.
